shared_elements: simple outline forms without interior modelling
isolated abstract signs on a broad surface
justification: The only real correspondence is generic: both surfaces carry schematic, outline-drawn curved or crescent-like signs with no interior detail, something almost any tradition could produce. Otherwise the content is unrelated — A shows a scatter of small red figures including a quadruped and boat-like arcs on an open rock face, while B is a monumental anthropomorphic figure with a face and a coherent programme of relief motifs (rings, bands, paired curls) arranged over head, shoulders and back.
